published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 714.9 as Night Elf on the same sim)

summary: Subtlety with Hemorrhage, Ghostly Strike and Preparation, on daggers.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when it's down. Refresh it at 5 when it's about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate. Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less
3-point Rupture when it's not up, with Hemorrhage right before it
Premeditation at 3 combo points or fewer (no Stealth needed)
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer, after pooling energy. A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld the same way. Preparation resets Vanish and Premeditation
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: The fight doesn't start in Stealth. Only Vanish, or a Night Elf's Shadowmeld, gives Stealth.
Ghostly Strike adds almost nothing over Hemorrhage (0.5 DPS), but the build requires it.
Open: whether Premeditation works out of Stealth, and what Preparation resets.
Elusiveness changes DPS by 0 at 180s and -2.9 at 300s.
Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Backstab and Eviscerate stop at rank VIII and Deadly Poison at IV. The books would add 13 to 18 DPS.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add about 8 and 6 DPS.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. The flask gives its full bonus only there.
No Flask of Natural Precision. Its 8% hit comes from gear (7% on the wrist, second ring and back) and the 2-piece bonus. That beats 6% hit by 1.2 to 1.9 DPS.
notes: Only Subtlety build, so treated as the Subtlety default. Undead since the second 2026-10-27 race re-pick (after dev notes post 8: Orc Blood Fury 2 min, Troll Berserking 15 s, Undead Touch of the Grave 15 s; the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Night Elf.
